title: uwip.3: convert lora_l2_tx CSMA to async CAD continuation; delete blocking lichen_lora_cad_run
description: Child 3 of uwip (consumes uwip.2). csma.c already exposes the two-phase lichen_csma_cad_begin/lichen_csma_cad_complete API - the CSMA engine is continuation-ready; only lichen_l2_tx.c's csma_cad callback (lora_l2_tx.c:109-115) still blocks in lichen_lora_cad_run. Convert: csma_cad becomes cad-begin (returns 0 with CAD in flight); the cad_registry done-callback computes the verdict and drives lichen_csma_cad_complete + the TX continuation. Delete lichen_lora_cad_run and the blocking poll path once csma.c stops using it. Preserve: CSMA-suppressed and state-recheck early returns, modem_mutex/tx_buf_mutex span, tx_pending arbitration, stop() cancellation semantics. Tests: ping_l2 native_sim on heft must build and run with the CSMA path exercised (CONFIG_LICHEN_LORA_CCA enabled variant) and no regression in the 4 passing tests; add a unit test for the async cad continuation if csma.c's structure permits.
close_reason: VERIFIED LANDED: the uwip.3 conversion is already fully in the tree (my earlier claim that it needed implementing was superseded by landed work). State verified: (1) lichen_lora_cad_run + the blocking poll path are DELETED - zero matches in lichen/. (2) lora_l2_tx.c csma_cad is async: csma_cad_probe arms lichen_lora_cad_start(dev, timeout, csma_cad_done, entry) and collects the verdict via bounded k_poll on a static per-device registry entry (no stack object shared with the completion context - this directly resolves worker-2's sysworkq spinlock panic, whose root cause was a stack cad_wait_ctx handoff). csma_cad_done only records verdict_busy + raises the signal, never blocks. (3) lr1110.c drives CadDone/CadDetected via a self-rescheduling k_work_delayable poll -> lichen_lora_cad_done; emulated (loopback NULL-start) delivers synchronous clear-channel. (4) csma.c exposes the two-phase lichen_csma_cad_begin/lichen_csma_cad_complete continuation API consumed by lichen_csma_acquire. (5) Unit test test_async_cad_emulated_completion exists in ping_l2 (arm/exclusive-EBUSY/verdict/re-arm/ETIMEDOUT-closed). ACCEPTANCE on heft native_sim/native/64 (Zephyr env, SDK 0.16.8): west build ping_l2 clean, CONFIG_LICHEN_LORA_CCA=y confirmed in .config, west build -t run = 8/8 PASS (test_async_cad_emulated_completion + the 4 pre-existing passing tests, no regression, no spinlock panic). No files changed this round - verification + close of already-merged work; 3x codereview N/A (no touched files). Cleaned up the heft build-dzyt-verify dir.
